newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to hold international investor "summit".
newsitem.headline: Hungary to hold international investor "summit".

text.p: Hungary announced on Wednesday it would bring together large international investors, banks and Hungarian government ministers next week to discuss investment opportunities for the next decade.

Privatisation Minister Judit Csiha said the World Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and companies including ABN-AMRO Bank, Unilever, Ameritech Corp and Lockheed Martin would attend the forum in Budapest on June 10 amd 11.

She said that, at the conference, entitled "Investors in Hungary Summit", Hungarian government ministers would be outlining investment opportunities in three main areas: infrastructure, the energy sector and tourism.
"We will outline the most significant development opportunites for the next five to ten years," Csiha told reporters.

Lockheed Martin is known to be interested in offering infrastructural investment as part of industrial packages which may count as offset in a $1 billion deal to supply fighters to Hungary's air force.
The Saab /British Aerospace consortium, McDonnell Douglas and Dassault are also in the race for a tender which is expected to be announced within the next year.
ABN-AMRO last year bought the Magyar Hitel Bank, while Ameritech, in a consortium with Deutsche Telekom, has a two-thirds stake in Hungarian telecommunications company MATAV.
